entries.name: Learning.bayesStationaryEnv_feedback_succ
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓔 : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {𝓨 : Type u_3} [inst : MeasurableSpace 𝓔] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨] {Q : MeasureTheory.Measure 𝓔} [inst_3 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure Q] {κ : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel (𝓔 × 𝓐) 𝓨} [inst_4 : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel κ] (n : ℕ), (Learning.bayesStationaryEnv Q κ).feedback (n + 1) = (ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.deterministic (Prod.fst ∘ fun p => ((p.1 0).2.1, p.2)) ⋯).prod (κ.comap (fun p => ((p.1 0).2.1, p.2)) ⋯)

entries.name: Learning.nextAction_detAlgorithm
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓞 : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {𝓨 : Type u_3} {m𝓞 : MeasurableSpace 𝓞} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} {nextA : (n : ℕ) → Learning.Hist 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨 n × 𝓞 → 𝓐} {h_next : ∀ (n : ℕ), Measurable (nextA n)} [MeasurableSpace.SeparatesPoints 𝓐] (n : ℕ), Learning.nextAction (Learning.detAlgorithm nextA h_next) n = nextA n

entries.name: Learning.nextAction_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓞 : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {𝓨 : Type u_3} {m𝓞 : MeasurableSpace 𝓞} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} (alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨) [inst : Learning.IsDeterministicAlg alg] (h : Learning.Hist 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨 0) (o : 𝓞), Learning.nextAction alg 0 (h, o) = Learning.actionZero alg o

entries.name: Learning.noObs
entries.statement: (Ω : Type u_5) → ℕ → Ω → Unit

entries.name: Learning.noObs_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_4} (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω), Learning.noObs Ω n ω = ()

entries.name: Learning.noiseSum
entries.statement: {Ω : Type u_1} → {𝓞 : Type u_2} → {𝓐 : Type u_3} → {𝓨 : Type u_4} → {m𝓞 : MeasurableSpace 𝓞} → {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} → {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} → [inst : NormedAddCommGroup 𝓨] → [NormedSpace ℝ 𝓨] → Learning.Environment 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨 → (ℕ → Ω → 𝓞) → (ℕ → Ω → 𝓐) → (ℕ → Ω → 𝓨) → 𝓐 → ℕ → Ω → 𝓨

entries.name: Learning.noiseSum_add_meanSum
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓞 : Type u_2} {𝓐 : Type u_3} {𝓨 : Type u_4} {m𝓞 : MeasurableSpace 𝓞} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup 𝓨] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ 𝓨] {O : ℕ → Ω → 𝓞} {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → 𝓨} {env : Learning.Environment 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨} [inst_2 : DecidableEq 𝓐] (k : 𝓐) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω), Learning.noiseSum env O A Y k n ω + Learning.meanSum env O A Y k n ω = Learning.sumRewards A Y k n ω

entries.name: Learning.noiseSum_add_meanSum'
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓞 : Type u_2} {𝓐 : Type u_3} {𝓨 : Type u_4} {m𝓞 : MeasurableSpace 𝓞} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup 𝓨] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ 𝓨] {O : ℕ → Ω → 𝓞} {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → 𝓨} {env : Learning.Environment 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨} (k : 𝓐) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω), Learning.noiseSum env O A Y k n ω + Learning.meanSum env O A Y k n ω = ∑ m ∈ Finset.range n, {ω | A m ω = k}.indicator (Y m) ω

entries.name: Learning.noiseSum_succ
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓞 : Type u_2} {𝓐 : Type u_3} {𝓨 : Type u_4} {m𝓞 : MeasurableSpace 𝓞} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup 𝓨] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ 𝓨] {O : ℕ → Ω → 𝓞} {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → 𝓨} {env : Learning.Environment 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨} (k : 𝓐) (n : ℕ), Learning.noiseSum env O A Y k (n + 1) = Learning.noiseSum env O A Y k n + {ω | A n ω = k}.indicator fun ω => Y n ω - env.means O A Y (A n ω) n ω

entries.name: Learning.noiseSum_succ_sub
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓞 : Type u_2} {𝓐 : Type u_3} {𝓨 : Type u_4} {m𝓞 : MeasurableSpace 𝓞} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup 𝓨] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ 𝓨] {O : ℕ → Ω → 𝓞} {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → 𝓨} {env : Learning.Environment 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨} (k : 𝓐) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω), Learning.noiseSum env O A Y k (n + 1) ω - Learning.noiseSum env O A Y k n ω = {ω | A n ω = k}.indicator (fun ω => Y n ω - env.means O A Y (A n ω) n ω) ω

entries.name: Learning.noiseSum_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {𝓞 : Type u_2} {𝓐 : Type u_3} {𝓨 : Type u_4} {m𝓞 : MeasurableSpace 𝓞} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup 𝓨] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ 𝓨] {O : ℕ → Ω → 𝓞} {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → 𝓨} {env : Learning.Environment 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨} (k : 𝓐), Learning.noiseSum env O A Y k 0 = fun x => 0

entries.name: Learning.obliviousEnv
entries.statement: {𝓐 : Type u_2} → {𝓨 : Type u_3} → {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} → {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} → (ν : ℕ → ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 𝓨) → [∀ (n : ℕ), ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel (ν n)] → Learning.Environment Unit 𝓐 𝓨

entries.name: Learning.obliviousEnv_feedback
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {𝓨 : Type u_3} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} (ν : ℕ → ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 𝓨) [inst : ∀ (n : ℕ), ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel (ν n)] (n : ℕ), (Learning.obliviousEnv ν).feedback n = ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.prodMkLeft (Learning.Hist Unit 𝓐 𝓨 n × Unit) (ν n)

entries.name: Learning.obliviousEnv_obs
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {𝓨 : Type u_3} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} (ν : ℕ → ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 𝓨) [inst : ∀ (n : ℕ), ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel (ν n)] (x : ℕ), (Learning.obliviousEnv ν).obs x = ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.const (Learning.Hist Unit 𝓐 𝓨 x) (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac ())

entries.name: Learning.obliviousEnv_ν0
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {𝓨 : Type u_2} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} (ν : ℕ → ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 𝓨) [inst : ∀ (n : ℕ), ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel (ν n)], (Learning.obliviousEnv ν).ν0 = ν 0

entries.name: Learning.obs0_bayesStationaryEnv
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓔 : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {𝓨 : Type u_3} [inst : MeasurableSpace 𝓔] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨] {Q : MeasureTheory.Measure 𝓔} [inst_3 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure Q] {κ : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel (𝓔 × 𝓐) 𝓨} [inst_4 : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel κ], (Learning.bayesStationaryEnv Q κ).obs0 = Q

entries.name: Learning.obs0_obliviousEnv
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {𝓨 : Type u_3} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} (ν : ℕ → ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 𝓨) [inst : ∀ (n : ℕ), ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel (ν n)], (Learning.obliviousEnv ν).obs0 = MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac ()

entries.name: Learning.obs0_stationaryEnv
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {𝓨 : Type u_3} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} (ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 𝓨) [inst : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν], (Learning.stationaryEnv ν).obs0 = MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac ()

entries.name: Learning.obs_bayesStationaryEnv_succ
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓔 : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {𝓨 : Type u_3} [inst : MeasurableSpace 𝓔] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨] {Q : MeasureTheory.Measure 𝓔} [inst_3 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure Q] {κ : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel (𝓔 × 𝓐) 𝓨} [inst_4 : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel κ] (n : ℕ), (Learning.bayesStationaryEnv Q κ).obs (n + 1) = ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.deterministic (fun h => (h 0).obs) ⋯

entries.name: Learning.obs_bayesStationaryEnv_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓔 : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {𝓨 : Type u_3} [inst : MeasurableSpace 𝓔] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨] {Q : MeasureTheory.Measure 𝓔} [inst_3 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure Q] {κ : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel (𝓔 × 𝓐) 𝓨} [inst_4 : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel κ], (Learning.bayesStationaryEnv Q κ).obs 0 = ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.const (Learning.Hist 𝓔 𝓐 𝓨 0) Q

entries.name: Learning.obs_detEnvironment
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓞 : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {𝓨 : Type u_3} {m𝓞 : MeasurableSpace 𝓞} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} {obs : (n : ℕ) → ProbabilityTheory.Kernel (Learning.Hist 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨 n) 𝓞} [inst : ∀ (n : ℕ), ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel (obs n)] {f : (n : ℕ) → (Learning.Hist 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨 n × 𝓞) × 𝓐 → 𝓨} {hf : ∀ (n : ℕ), Measurable (f n)} (n : ℕ), (Learning.detEnvironment obs f hf).obs n = obs n

entries.name: Learning.obs_eval_comp_history
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓞 : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {𝓨 : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} {O : ℕ → Ω → 𝓞} {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → 𝓨} (n : ℕ), (fun x => (x (Fin.last n)).obs) ∘ Learning.history O A Y (n + 1) = O n

entries.name: Learning.obs_stationaryEnv
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {𝓨 : Type u_3} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} (ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 𝓨) [inst : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] (n : ℕ), (Learning.stationaryEnv ν).obs n = ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.const (Learning.Hist Unit 𝓐 𝓨 n) (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac ())

entries.name: Learning.obs_step
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓞 : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {𝓨 : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} {O : ℕ → Ω → 𝓞} {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → 𝓨} (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω), (Learning.step O A Y n ω).obs = O n ω

entries.name: Learning.onlineEvalEnv
entries.statement: {𝓐 : Type u_1} → {𝓨 : Type u_2} → {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} → {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} → (g : ℕ → 𝓐 → 𝓨) → (∀ (n : ℕ), Measurable (g n)) → Learning.Environment Unit 𝓐 𝓨

entries.name: Learning.p0_detAlgorithm
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓞 : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {𝓨 : Type u_3} {m𝓞 : MeasurableSpace 𝓞} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} {nextA : (n : ℕ) → Learning.Hist 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨 n × 𝓞 → 𝓐} {h_next : ∀ (n : ℕ), Measurable (nextA n)}, (Learning.detAlgorithm nextA h_next).p0 = ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.deterministic (fun o => nextA 0 (default, o)) ⋯

entries.name: Learning.p0_eq_deterministic
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓞 : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {𝓨 : Type u_3} {m𝓞 : MeasurableSpace 𝓞} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} (alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨) [inst : Learning.IsDeterministicAlg alg], alg.p0 = ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.deterministic (Learning.actionZero alg) ⋯

entries.name: Learning.p0_eq_dirac
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {𝓨 : Type u_2} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} (alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 𝓨) [inst : Learning.IsDeterministicAlg alg], alg.p0 = MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac (Learning.actionZero alg)

entries.name: Learning.policy_eq_deterministic
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓞 : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {𝓨 : Type u_3} {m𝓞 : MeasurableSpace 𝓞} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} (alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨) [h_det : Learning.IsDeterministicAlg alg] (n : ℕ), alg.policy n = ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.deterministic (Learning.nextAction alg n) ⋯

entries.name: Learning.pullCount
entries.statement: {𝓐 : Type u_2} → {Ω : Type u_4} → [DecidableEq 𝓐] → (ℕ → Ω → 𝓐) → 𝓐 → ℕ → Ω → ℕ

entries.name: Learning.pullCount'
entries.statement: {𝓞 : Type u_1} → {𝓐 : Type u_2} → {R : Type u_3} → [DecidableEq 𝓐] → (n : ℕ) → Learning.Hist 𝓞 𝓐 R n → 𝓐 → ℕ

entries.name: Learning.pullCount'_eq_sum
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓞 : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] (n : ℕ) (h : Learning.Hist 𝓞 𝓐 R n) (a : 𝓐), Learning.pullCount' n h a = ∑ s, if (h s).action = a then 1 else 0

entries.name: Learning.pullCount'_mono
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓞 : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {O : ℕ → Ω → 𝓞} {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} {a : 𝓐} {ω : Ω} {n m : ℕ}, n ≤ m → Learning.pullCount' n (Learning.history O A R' n ω) a ≤ Learning.pullCount' m (Learning.history O A R' m ω) a

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_action_eq_pullCount_add_one
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} (t : ℕ) (ω : Ω), Learning.pullCount A (A t ω) (t + 1) ω = Learning.pullCount A (A t ω) t ω + 1

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_add_one
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {t : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, Learning.pullCount A a (t + 1) ω = Learning.pullCount A a t ω + if A t ω = a then 1 else 0

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_add_one_eq_of_stepsUntil_eq_coe
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {m n : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω = ↑n → Learning.pullCount A a (n + 1) ω = m

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_add_one_eq_pullCount'
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} {a : 𝓐} {n : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, Learning.pullCount A a (n + 1) ω = Learning.pullCount' n (fun i => (A (↑i) ω, R' (↑i) ω)) a

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_congr
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {n : ℕ} {ω ω' : Ω}, (∀ i ≤ n, A i ω = A i ω') → Learning.pullCount A a (n + 1) ω = Learning.pullCount A a (n + 1) ω'

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_eq_comp_history
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓞 : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {O : ℕ → Ω → 𝓞} {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} (a : 𝓐) (n : ℕ), Learning.pullCount A a n = (fun h => Learning.pullCount' n h a) ∘ Learning.history O A R' n

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_eq_of_stepsUntil_eq_coe
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {m n : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, m ≠ 0 → Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω = ↑n → Learning.pullCount A a n ω = m - 1

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_eq_pullCount'
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓞 : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {O : ℕ → Ω → 𝓞} {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} {a : 𝓐} {n : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, Learning.pullCount A a n ω = Learning.pullCount' n (Learning.history O A R' n ω) a

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_eq_pullCount_of_action_ne
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {t : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, A t ω ≠ a → Learning.pullCount A a (t + 1) ω = Learning.pullCount A a t ω

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_eq_sum
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} (a : 𝓐) (t : ℕ) (ω : Ω), Learning.pullCount A a t ω = ∑ s ∈ Finset.range t, if A s ω = a then 1 else 0

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_le
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} (a : 𝓐) (t : ℕ) (ω : Ω), Learning.pullCount A a t ω ≤ t

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_le_add
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} (a : 𝓐) (n C : ℕ) (ω : Ω), Learning.pullCount A a n ω ≤ C + 1 + ∑ s ∈ Finset.range n, {s | A s ω = a ∧ C < Learning.pullCount A a s ω}.indicator 1 s

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_lt_of_forall_ne
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {n t : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, (∀ (s : ℕ), Learning.pullCount A a (s + 1) ω ≠ t) → t ≠ 0 → Learning.pullCount A a n ω < t

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_lt_of_le_stepsUntil
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} (a : 𝓐) {n m : ℕ} (ω : Ω), (∃ s, Learning.pullCount A a (s + 1) ω = m) → ↑n < Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω → Learning.pullCount A a (n + 1) ω < m

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_mono
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} (a : 𝓐) {n m : ℕ}, n ≤ m → ∀ (ω : Ω), Learning.pullCount A a n ω ≤ Learning.pullCount A a m ω

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_one
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {ω : Ω}, Learning.pullCount A a 1 ω = if A 0 ω = a then 1 else 0

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_stepsUntil
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {m : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, m ≠ 0 → (∃ s, Learning.pullCount A a (s + 1) ω = m) → Learning.pullCount A a (Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω).toNat ω = m - 1

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_stepsUntil_add_one

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} (a : 𝓐), Learning.pullCount A a 0 = 0

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_zero_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} (a : 𝓐) (ω : Ω), Learning.pullCount A a 0 ω = 0

entries.name: Learning.randomSampling_p0

entries.name: Learning.randomSampling_policy
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓞 : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {𝓨 : Type u_3} {m𝓞 : MeasurableSpace 𝓞} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure 𝓐) [inst : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (x : ℕ), (Learning.randomSampling μ).policy x = ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.const (Learning.Hist 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨 x × 𝓞) μ

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCount
entries.statement: {𝓐 : Type u_2} → {R : Type u_3} → {Ω : Type u_4} → [DecidableEq 𝓐] → (ℕ → Ω → 𝓐) → (ℕ → Ω → R) → 𝓐 → ℕ → Ω × (ℕ → 𝓐 → R) → R

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCountUntil
entries.statement: {𝓐 : Type u_2} → {R : Type u_3} → {Ω : Type u_4} → [DecidableEq 𝓐] → (ℕ → Ω → 𝓐) → (ℕ → Ω → R) → ℕ → Ω × (ℕ → 𝓐 → R) → 𝓐 × ℕ → R

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCountUntil_add_one
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} (t : ℕ) (ω : Ω × (ℕ → 𝓐 → R)), Learning.rewardByCountUntil A R' (t + 1) ω = Function.update (Learning.rewardByCountUntil A R' t ω) (A t ω.1, Learning.pullCount A (A t ω.1) t ω.1) (R' t ω.1)

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCountUntil_apply_of_lt_pullCount
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} {a : 𝓐} {m t : ℕ} {ω : Ω × (ℕ → 𝓐 → R)}, m < Learning.pullCount A a t ω.1 → Learning.rewardByCountUntil A R' t ω (a, m) = Learning.rewardByCount A R' a (m + 1) ω

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCountUntil_apply_of_pullCount_le
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} {a : 𝓐} {m t : ℕ} {ω : Ω × (ℕ → 𝓐 → R)}, Learning.pullCount A a t ω.1 ≤ m → Learning.rewardByCountUntil A R' t ω (a, m) = ω.2 (m + 1) a

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCountUntil_congr
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} {x : Ω} {z z' : ℕ → 𝓐 → R} (t : ℕ) (p : 𝓐 × ℕ), z (p.2 + 1) p.1 = z' (p.2 + 1) p.1 → Learning.rewardByCountUntil A R' t (x, z) p = Learning.rewardByCountUntil A R' t (x, z') p

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCountUntil_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} (ω : Ω × (ℕ → 𝓐 → R)), Learning.rewardByCountUntil A R' 0 ω = fun p => ω.2 (p.2 + 1) p.1

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCount_eq_add
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} [inst_1 : AddMonoid R] (a : 𝓐) (m : ℕ), Learning.rewardByCount A R' a m = ({ω | Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω.1 ≠ ⊤}.indicator fun ω => R' (Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω.1).toNat ω.1) + {ω | Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω.1 = ⊤}.indicator fun ω => ω.2 m a

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCount_eq_ite
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} (a : 𝓐) (m : ℕ) (ω : Ω × (ℕ → 𝓐 → R)), Learning.rewardByCount A R' a m ω = if Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω.1 = ⊤ then ω.2 m a else R' (Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω.1).toNat ω.1

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCount_eq_stoppedValue
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} {a : 𝓐} {m : ℕ} {ω : Ω × (ℕ → 𝓐 → R)}, Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω.1 ≠ ⊤ → Learning.rewardByCount A R' a m ω = MeasureTheory.stoppedValue R' (Learning.stepsUntil A a m) ω.1

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCount_of_stepsUntil_eq_coe
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} {a : 𝓐} {m n : ℕ} {ω : Ω × (ℕ → 𝓐 → R)}, Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω.1 = ↑n → Learning.rewardByCount A R' a m ω = R' n ω.1

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCount_of_stepsUntil_eq_top
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} {a : 𝓐} {m : ℕ} {ω : Ω × (ℕ → 𝓐 → R)}, Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω.1 = ⊤ → Learning.rewardByCount A R' a m ω = ω.2 m a

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCount_of_stepsUntil_ne_top
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} {a : 𝓐} {m : ℕ} {ω : Ω × (ℕ → 𝓐 → R)}, Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω.1 ≠ ⊤ → Learning.rewardByCount A R' a m ω = R' (Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω.1).toNat ω.1

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCount_pullCount_add_one_eq_reward
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} (t : ℕ) (ω : Ω × (ℕ → 𝓐 → R)), Learning.rewardByCount A R' (A t ω.1) (Learning.pullCount A (A t ω.1) t ω.1 + 1) ω = R' t ω.1

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCount_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} (a : 𝓐) (ω : Ω × (ℕ → 𝓐 → R)), Learning.rewardByCount A R' a 0 ω = if A 0 ω.1 = a then ω.2 0 a else R' 0 ω.1

entries.name: Learning.roundRobinAlgorithm
entries.statement: {𝓞 : Type u_1} → {𝓨 : Type u_2} → {m𝓞 : MeasurableSpace 𝓞} → {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} → {K : ℕ} → 0 < K → Learning.Algorithm 𝓞 (Fin K) 𝓨

entries.name: Learning.setOf_action_eq_and_pullCount_eq_eq_preimage
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓞 : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {O : ℕ → Ω → 𝓞} {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} (n : ℕ) (b : 𝓐) (k : ℕ), {x | A n x = b ∧ Learning.pullCount A b n x = k} = (fun x => ((Learning.history O A R' n x, O n x), A n x)) ⁻¹' {u | u.2 = b ∧ Learning.pullCount' n u.1.1 b = k}

entries.name: Learning.snd_eval_comp_history
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {𝓨 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_3} {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → 𝓨} (n : ℕ), (fun x => (x (Fin.last n)).2) ∘ Learning.history A Y (n + 1) = Y n

entries.name: Learning.stationaryEnv
entries.statement: {𝓐 : Type u_2} → {𝓨 : Type u_3} → {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} → {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} → (ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 𝓨) → [ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] → Learning.Environment Unit 𝓐 𝓨

entries.name: Learning.step
entries.statement: {𝓞 : Type u_1} → {𝓐 : Type u_2} → {𝓨 : Type u_3} → {Ω : Type u_4} → (ℕ → Ω → 𝓞) → (ℕ → Ω → 𝓐) → (ℕ → Ω → 𝓨) → ℕ → Ω → Learning.Round 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨

entries.name: Learning.stepKernel
entries.statement: {𝓞 : Type u_1} → {𝓐 : Type u_2} → {𝓨 : Type u_3} → {m𝓞 : MeasurableSpace 𝓞} → {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} → {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} → Learning.Algorithm 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨 → Learning.Environment 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨 → (n : ℕ) → ProbabilityTheory.Kernel (Learning.Hist 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨 n) (Learning.Round 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨)

entries.name: Learning.stepKernel_def
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓞 : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {𝓨 : Type u_3} {m𝓞 : MeasurableSpace 𝓞} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} (alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨) (env : Learning.Environment 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨) (n : ℕ), Learning.stepKernel alg env n = (env.obs n).compProd ((alg.policy n).compProd (env.feedback n))

entries.name: Learning.stepKernel_stationaryEnv
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {𝓨 : Type u_3} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} (alg : Learning.Algorithm Unit 𝓐 𝓨) (η : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 𝓨) [inst : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel η] (n : ℕ), Learning.stepKernel alg (Learning.stationaryEnv η) n = (ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.const (Learning.Hist Unit 𝓐 𝓨 n) (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac ())).compProd ((alg.policy n).compProd (ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.prodMkLeft (Learning.Hist Unit 𝓐 𝓨 n × Unit) η))

entries.name: Learning.stepKernel_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓞 : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {𝓨 : Type u_3} {m𝓞 : MeasurableSpace 𝓞} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} (alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨) (env : Learning.Environment 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨) (h : Learning.Hist 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨 0), (Learning.stepKernel alg env 0) h = env.obs0.compProd (alg.p0.compProd env.ν0)

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil
entries.statement: {𝓐 : Type u_2} → {Ω : Type u_4} → [DecidableEq 𝓐] → (ℕ → Ω → 𝓐) → 𝓐 → ℕ → Ω → ℕ∞

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_eq_congr
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {m n : ℕ} {ω ω' : Ω}, (∀ i ≤ n, A i ω = A i ω') → (Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω = ↑n ↔ Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω' = ↑n)

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_eq_dite
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} (a : 𝓐) (m : ℕ) (ω : Ω) [inst_1 : Decidable (∃ s, Learning.pullCount A a (s + 1) ω = m)], Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω = if h : ∃ s, Learning.pullCount A a (s + 1) ω = m then ↑(Nat.find h) else ⊤

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_eq_iff
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {m : ℕ} {ω : Ω} (n : ℕ), Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω = ↑n ↔ Learning.pullCount A a (n + 1) ω = m ∧ ∀ k < n, Learning.pullCount A a (k + 1) ω < m

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_eq_iff'
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {m : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, m ≠ 0 → ∀ (n : ℕ), Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω = ↑n ↔ A n ω = a ∧ Learning.pullCount A a n ω = m - 1

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_eq_leastGE
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {m : ℕ} (a : 𝓐), m ≠ 0 → Learning.stepsUntil A a m = MeasureTheory.leastGE (fun n ω => Learning.pullCount A a (n + 1) ω) m

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_eq_top_iff
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {m : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω = ⊤ ↔ ∀ (s : ℕ), Learning.pullCount A a (s + 1) ω ≠ m

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_eq_zero_iff
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {m : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω = 0 ↔ m = 0 ∧ A 0 ω ≠ a ∨ m = 1 ∧ A 0 ω = a

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_mono
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} (a : 𝓐) (ω : Ω) {n m : ℕ}, n ≠ 0 → n ≤ m → Learning.stepsUntil A a n ω ≤ Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_ne_top
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {m : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, (∃ s, Learning.pullCount A a (s + 1) ω = m) → Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω ≠ ⊤

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_one_of_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {ω : Ω}, A 0 ω = a → Learning.stepsUntil A a 1 ω = 0

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_pullCount_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} (ω : Ω) (t : ℕ), Learning.stepsUntil A (A t ω) (Learning.pullCount A (A t ω) (t + 1) ω) ω = ↑t

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_pullCount_le
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} (ω : Ω) (a : 𝓐) (t : ℕ), Learning.stepsUntil A a (Learning.pullCount A a (t + 1) ω) ω ≤ ↑t

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_zero_of_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {ω : Ω}, A 0 ω = a → Learning.stepsUntil A a 0 ω = ⊤

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_zero_of_ne
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {ω : Ω}, A 0 ω ≠ a → Learning.stepsUntil A a 0 ω = 0

entries.name: Learning.stronglyAdapted_pullCount_add_one
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓞 : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} {m𝓞 : MeasurableSpace 𝓞} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {mR : MeasurableSpace R} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓞 𝓐 R} {env : Learning.Environment 𝓞 𝓐 R} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {O : ℕ → Ω → 𝓞} {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} [MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] (h : Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq O A R' alg env P) (a : 𝓐), MeasureTheory.StronglyAdapted h.filtration fun n => Learning.pullCount A a (n + 1)

entries.name: Learning.sumRewards
entries.statement: {𝓐 : Type u_2} → {𝓨 : Type u_3} → {Ω : Type u_4} → [DecidableEq 𝓐] → [AddCommGroup 𝓨] → (ℕ → Ω → 𝓐) → (ℕ → Ω → 𝓨) → 𝓐 → ℕ → Ω → 𝓨

entries.name: Learning.sumRewards'
entries.statement: {𝓞 : Type u_1} → {𝓐 : Type u_2} → {𝓨 : Type u_3} → [DecidableEq 𝓐] → [AddCommGroup 𝓨] → (n : ℕ) → Learning.Hist 𝓞 𝓐 𝓨 n → 𝓐 → 𝓨

entries.name: Learning.sumRewards_add_one
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {𝓨 : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup 𝓨] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {t : ℕ} {ω : Ω} {R : ℕ → Ω → 𝓨}, Learning.sumRewards A R a (t + 1) ω = Learning.sumRewards A R a t ω + if A t ω = a then R t ω else 0

entries.name: Learning.sumRewards_add_one_eq_sumRewards'
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {𝓨 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup 𝓨] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {R : ℕ → Ω → 𝓨} {n : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, Learning.sumRewards A R a (n + 1) ω = Learning.sumRewards' n (fun i => (A (↑i) ω, R (↑i) ω)) a

entries.name: Learning.sumRewards_eq_comp_history
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓞 : Type u_1} {𝓐 : Type u_2} {𝓨 : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup 𝓨] {O : ℕ → Ω → 𝓞} {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R : ℕ → Ω → 𝓨} (a : 𝓐) (n : ℕ), Learning.sumRewards A R a n = (fun h => Learning.sumRewards' n h a) ∘ Learning.history O A R n

entries.name: Learning.sumRewards_eq_of_pullCount_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {𝓨 : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup 𝓨] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {ω : Ω} {R : ℕ → Ω → 𝓨} {s t : ℕ}, Learning.pullCount A a s ω = Learning.pullCount A a t ω → Learning.sumRewards A R a s ω = Learning.sumRewards A R a t ω

entries.name: Learning.sumRewards_eq_pullCount_mul_empMean

entries.name: Learning.sumRewards_sub_pullCount_mul_eq_sum

entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_2} {𝓨 : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup 𝓨] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {n : ℕ} {ω : Ω} {R : ℕ → Ω → 𝓨} (c : 𝓐 → 𝓨), Learning.sumRewards A R a (n + 1) ω - Learning.pullCount A a (n + 1) ω • c a = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), if A i ω = a then R i ω - c a else 0

entries.name: Bandits.UCB.pullCount_ae_le_add_two
entries.statement: ∀ {K : ℕ} {hK : 0 < K} {c : ℝ} {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel (Fin K) ℝ} [inst : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {Ω : Type u_1} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {O : ℕ → Ω → Unit} {A : ℕ → Ω → Fin K} {R : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {σ2 : NNReal} [inst_2 : Nonempty (Fin K)], Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq O A R (Bandits.ucbAlgorithm hK (c * ↑σ2)) (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P → 0 ≤ c → ∀ (a : Fin K), 0 < Bandits.gap ν a → ∀ (n C : ℕ), C ≠ 0 → 8 * c * ↑σ2 * Real.log (↑n + 1) / Bandits.gap ν a ^ 2 ≤ ↑C → ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P, Learning.pullCount A a n ω ≤ C + 1 + ∑ s ∈ Finset.range n, {s | 0 < Learning.pullCount A (Bandits.bestArm ν) s ω ∧ Learning.empMean A R (Bandits.bestArm ν) s ω + Bandits.UCB.ucbWidth A (c * ↑σ2) (Bandits.bestArm ν) s ω < ∫ (x : ℝ), id x ∂ν (Bandits.bestArm ν)}.indicator 1 s + ∑ s ∈ Finset.range n, {s | 0 < Learning.pullCount A a s ω ∧ ∫ (x : ℝ), id x ∂ν a < Learning.empMean A R a s ω - Bandits.UCB.ucbWidth A (c * ↑σ2) a s ω}.indicator 1 s
